findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 558 requests to 108 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 3.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.5 MB (44%) came from third-party domains, 1.3 MB of it from services classified as tracking (432 requests).

57 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
296 cookies were set by third-party domains (322 cookies in total).
The address redirected 1 time(s): https://www.independent.co.uk/ -> https://www.independent.co.uk/us

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 125 requests were blocked. The page still made 558 requests to 108 third-party domains, including 57 tracking services in our list.
